cache_scope: Only transformed immutable model parameters; no x, routing-ID, output or trajectory cache. Weak owner lifetime and parameter object signatures prevent stale reuse after updates.
estimated_model_contribution: Unverified. The targeted up/gate region costs0.379ms per sampled expert; reducing Python/dispatch work could save only a small fraction. No measured dispatch-gap or DRAM-bound claim.
hypothesis: Losslessly pack native up/gate weights/scales/biases along output-row dimension, then use one native gather_qmm and the unchanged native SwiGLU/down kernels. Preserve native reduction implementation instead of changed custom reductions that caused rare amplified rounding errors.
layout_conversion: One-time bit-preserving output-row concatenation; original per-projection fields become views into the same packed buffers so steady-state weights are not duplicated. A controller preparation API restores native contiguous fields before baseline timing and packs outside candidate timing. Setup time/temporary allocation must be reported separately. No source checkpoint or precision changes.
required_before_timing: all saved failing real full-model boundary cases exact

timing_layout_fairness.baseline: Restore native contiguous parameter fields before every native lane; no packed parameter cache is used by timed baseline calls.
timing_layout_fairness.candidate: Prepare losslessly packed fields before each candidate lane; setup excluded from resident timing but every preparation duration/active-memory/peak is retained.
timing_layout_fairness.interpretation: Setup is model representation work. No request inputs or outputs are cached. Report setup and temporary memory independently; no full-model speedup from these operator data.
timing_layout_fairness.priming: Fixed1024call native primer per pair plus32call same-lane primer per microblock after layout setup, applied to both implementations. Timed calls remain1024 per lane; all raw counts retained.
timing_layout_fairness.stale_loading_refs: Delete sampled parameter-loading lists before packing so original buffers are not artificially retained.
